svg.title: Logging Large Strings — 4 Concurrent Threads
svg.desc: Log-scale frontend latency profile for 13 logging libraries. Series use color and marker shape. Lower values are better; Quill series are emphasized and the panel ranks 99th-percentile latency. Equal percentile values share a rank. Visually overlapping markers are offset horizontally while retaining their exact value-bearing vertical position. Quill results use v13.0.0.
